summary: Khi bat hwaccel=vaapi, video goc cung duoc giai ma bang GPU Intel: proxy 4K H.264 ton CPU it hon khoang 38 lan va nhanh hon khoang 5 lan.
changes: Che do vaapi gio giai ma, thu nho va ma hoa deu tren GPU. Truoc day video goc 4K H.264 van giai ma bang CPU, chiem gan het tai CPU.
Video GPU khong giai ma duoc (vi du H.264 4:2:2 10-bit) tu dong giai ma bang CPU nhu cu, roi ma hoa bang GPU.
Video HEVC 10-bit duoc chuyen sang 8-bit ngay tren GPU truoc khi ma hoa H.264.
